name: Rockwell Automation

eyebrow.en: Rockwell Automation, Inc. · Common stock · Milwaukee, Wisconsin
eyebrow.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 · 普通股 · 威斯康星州密尔沃基

title.en: Factory automation, pulled along by chip fabs and data centers.
title.zh: 工厂自动化，由晶圆厂与数据中心拉动。

lede.en: Rockwell sells the controllers, drives, sensors and software that run factories, warehouses and process plants. September-quarter sales rose only 1% to $2.33B and missed estimates, because Rockwell handed tariff refunds back to customers; without that and a divestiture, core sales grew 7%. The first FY27 outlook calls for 6–9% organic growth and adjusted EPS of $14.50–15.50. The stock fell 14% on the report and now trades at about 26 times next year's earnings.
lede.zh: 罗克韦尔销售运行工厂、仓库和流程工厂的控制器、驱动器、传感器和软件。9月季度销售仅增长 1% 至 23.3 亿美元，低于预期，原因是公司将关税退款返还给客户；剔除这一因素及业务剥离，核心销售增长 7%。首份 FY27 展望预计有机增长 6–9%，调整后每股收益 $14.50–15.50。财报后股价下跌 14%，目前约为明年盈利的 26 倍。

s.en: adj. EPS $13.42 · forward ~26× on ~$14.9 FY27 consensus
s.zh: 调整后每股 $13.42 · 按约 $14.9 的 FY27 一致预期计约 26 倍

s.en: adj. EPS · sales up low single digits (organic mid)
s.zh: 调整后每股 · 销售低个位数增长（有机中个位数）

s.en: Q1 FY27 · date not yet set (last year Feb 5)
s.zh: FY27 第一季 · 日期未定（去年为2月5日）

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Rockwell has closed between about $400 and $495 since May.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。罗克韦尔自5月以来收盘价在约 $400 至 $495 之间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Rockwell's fiscal year ends September 30. Gross margin steps up from about 40% to about 48% in FY25 in the source data; the FY24 and FY25 fourth-quarter figures are left blank because the source shows outliers, and Q4 FY26's 51.9% is lifted by $103M of tariff refunds booked against cost of sales. The last bar is a Q1 FY27 estimate: management expects reported sales up low single digits (about $2.16B).
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。罗克韦尔财年于9月30日结束。数据源中毛利率在 FY25 由约 40% 升至约 48%；FY24 与 FY25 第四季数字因数据源异常而留空，FY26 第四季 51.9% 的毛利率受计入销售成本的 1.03 亿美元关税退款推高。最后一根柱为 FY27 第一季估算：管理层预计报告销售低个位数增长（约 21.6 亿美元）。

s.zh: 同比 +1% · 有机 +3%（关税退款 −4 个百分点）
企业口径 · 去年 21.3% · 退款贡献 1.3 个百分点
调整后每股 · 有机销售 +6–9%

p.en: Semiconductor and data center, reported as one vertical from FY27, are about 10% of sales and expected to grow mid-teens. Hyperscale operator QTS standardized on Rockwell in Q4.
p.zh: 半导体与数据中心自 FY27 起合并为一个垂直市场披露，约占销售 10%，预计增长十几个百分点。超大规模运营商 QTS 在 Q4 全面采用罗克韦尔方案。

p.en: Enterprise operating margin was above 22% for three straight quarters, hitting the long-term target early; FY27 guides about 23%. New targets come at the Nov 18 investor day.
p.zh: 企业营业利润率连续三季高于 22%，提前达成长期目标；FY27 指引约 23%。新目标将于11月18日投资者日公布。

p.en: Q1 FY27 adjusted EPS is guided near $3.00, with organic sales up mid-single digits and about $50M of lost Sensia sales in each of Q1 and Q2.
p.zh: FY27 第一季调整后每股指引约 $3.00，有机销售中个位数增长，Q1 和 Q2 各因 Sensia 损失约 5,000 万美元销售。

p.en: Organic annual recurring revenue grew 5% in FY26, slower than before; management expects it to pick up to 7% in FY27.
p.zh: FY26 有机年度经常性收入增长 5%，较此前放缓；管理层预计 FY27 回升至 7%。

p.en: Memory and circuit-board inflation has not eased, mining sales fell about 10% on project delays, and capex rises to about 4% of sales for a new US plant.
p.zh: 内存与电路板通胀未见缓解，采矿业务因项目延迟下滑约 10%，资本开支将升至销售的约 4%，用于新建美国工厂。

p.en: The FY27 EPS midpoint is only about 1% above consensus. Even after the 14% drop, the stock trades at about 26 times next year's earnings.
p.zh: FY27 每股收益指引中值仅比一致预期高约 1%。即便下跌 14% 后，股价仍约为明年盈利的 26 倍。

p.en: Rockwell's annual customer show in Boston, where new products are launched.
p.zh: 罗克韦尔在波士顿举办的年度客户展会，发布新产品。

p.en: Management will update its long-term targets, including margins, after reaching the 22% goal early.
p.zh: 提前达成 22% 目标后，管理层将更新包括利润率在内的长期目标。

p.en: The seasonal low quarter; guided to adjusted EPS of about $3.00. Date not yet announced.
p.zh: 季节性低点季度；调整后每股指引约 $3.00。日期尚未公布。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 5, 2026 (Q4 FY26 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Rockwell Automation, Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月5日（FY26 第四季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Rockwell Automation, Inc. 无关联。

guide: Dec 2026 · CFO: sales up low single digits
2026年12月 · CFO：销售低个位数增长

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q1 FY22 to Q4 FY26. Rockwell's fiscal year ends September 30. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第一季至 FY26 第四季共 20 个季度。罗克韦尔财年于9月30日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Rockwell's free cash flow is seasonal: the December quarter is usually the weakest and the second half the strongest. FY26 brought a record $1.70B, 113% of adjusted net income, including $602M in Q4, helped by $108M of US tariff refunds and interest.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自由现金流有季节性：12月季度通常最弱，下半财年最强。FY26 创下 17.0 亿美元纪录，相当于调整后净利润的 113%，其中 Q4 为 6.02 亿，受益于 1.08 亿美元的美国关税退款及利息。

read.en: My base case follows the FY27 guide: about 100% conversion of roughly $1.65B of adjusted net income ($15.00 EPS on ~110M shares), with capex rising to about 4% of sales for a new US plant. That gives about $1.65B over four quarters, slightly above FY26 once the one-off refunds are removed. The main risk is the industrial cycle: in FY24, when customers cut inventory, quarterly free cash flow fell as low as −$35M.
read.zh: 我的基准情景沿用 FY27 指引：约 16.5 亿美元调整后净利润（每股 $15.00、约 1.1 亿股）约 100% 转化为现金，资本开支因新建美国工厂升至销售的约 4%。四季合计约 16.5 亿美元，剔除一次性退款后略高于 FY26。主要风险是工业周期：FY24 客户去库存时，季度自由现金流一度低至 −3,500 万美元。

p.en: About $160M a quarter after the October raise to $1.45 per share.
p.zh: 10月上调至每股 $1.45 后，每季约 1.6 亿美元。

p.en: $1.26B of repurchases in FY26, including $500M in Q4; about $600M planned for FY27.
p.zh: FY26 回购 12.6 亿美元，其中 Q4 5 亿；FY27 计划约 6 亿。

p.en: Rising from $257M in FY26 to about 4% of sales, roughly $380M, in FY27.
p.zh: 由 FY26 的 2.57 亿美元升至 FY27 销售的约 4%，约 3.8 亿。

p.en: Core sales grew 7% in Q4, and FY27 guides 6–9% organic growth.
p.zh: Q4 核心销售增长 7%，FY27 指引有机增长 6–9%。

p.en: Enterprise operating margin is guided to about 23% in FY27, up about 1 point.
p.zh: FY27 企业营业利润率指引约 23%，提升约 1 个百分点。

p.en: $103M of refunds plus $5M of interest arrived in Q4, a one-off boost to FY26 cash.
p.zh: Q4 收到 1.03 亿美元退款及 500 万利息，一次性提振 FY26 现金。

bridgeNote.en: Rockwell runs with little cash and has funded part of its buybacks with debt. With FY27 buybacks planned at about half of FY26's, cash could build modestly.
bridgeNote.zh: 罗克韦尔现金较少，部分回购以债务融资。FY27 计划回购约为 FY26 的一半，现金可能小幅累积。
